title: Renewal Pursuit Operations Notebook - Q2 Prep
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is a working ops notebook for active renewal pursuits in the next 180 days. Focus is on tracking customer dates, ARR exposure, highest-risk deals, immediate next actions, and proposed playbook steps for CS reps to run during QBR cycles or targeted outreach.

Column headers (sheet view):
Customer, Account Tier, Contract End Date, ARR (USD), Renewal Window Start, Renewal Window End, Renewal Lead, Probability (%), Next Step, Next Step Owner, Next Step Date, Playbook Suggested, Escalation Required, Last Contacted, Notes / Risks, Relevant Links

Sample rows (working data):
Acme Analytics, Enterprise, 2026-06-14, 420000, 2026-03-16, 2026-06-14, Aisha Patel, 65, Schedule technical health-check + usage QBR, Aisha Patel, 2026-03-22, Value-based QBR + ROI summary, yes (sales-eng), 2026-03-01, Low query perf spikes; customer wants 99.9% SLA. Confluence:CS/Acme-incident-2026; JIRA:ACME-117
Nimbus Retail, Growth, 2026-07-02, 108000, 2026-04-03, 2026-07-02, Marcus Lin, 45, Re-introduce Dedicated offering + pricing scenarios, Marcus Lin, 2026-04-06, Dedicated-savings play + heatmap, yes (pricing), 2026-03-29, Exec change (CTO left). Risk: procurement timeline unknown. Confluence:Nimbus/renewal-notes
BlueOrb Fin, Enterprise, 2026-05-30, 780000, 2026-02-28, 2026-05-30, Priya Kapoor, 85, Prepare contract amendment with higher commitment, Priya Kapoor, 2026-03-10, Commit & save pricing play, no, 2026-03-03, Already verbally committed; need legal loop. JIRA:BO-940
Helix Labs, SMB, 2026-08-19, 24000, 2026-05-20, 2026-08-19, Ethan Cole, 30, Expansion call to discuss embedding costs & integration, Ethan Cole, 2026-04-12, Expansion-to-dedicated-play, maybe, 2026-03-15, Low usage historically; churn risk if not engaged
Orchid Media, Growth, 2026-06-01, 156000, 2026-03-02, 2026-06-01, Aisha Patel, 55, Run quality/regression evals and share results, Engineering, 2026-03-18, Quality-assurance playbook, no, 2026-03-08, Reported accuracy regression on long-form generation. Linked PR: github.com/redwood/pr/6824

Working notes / decisions required:
- Probability model: use 3-factor adjustment (exec engagement, product health, procurement readiness). Current % are subjective; propose scoring rubric to standardize by 2026-04-09 (owner: Jordan Reyes).
- Escalation policy draft: define explicit thresholds for 'escalation required' column (suggested: ARR > 250k AND probability < 60% -> auto-escalate to AE + Solutions Eng). Feedback needed from Sales Ops.
- Playbook templates to attach per play (Value-based QBR, Cost-savings demo, Feature roadmapping session). See Confluence:CS/playbooks-q2-2026 for templates.
- Data sync: this sheet consumes output from renewals-telemetry ETL (Slack: #data-sync). Need weekly refresh via script CS-refresh-job (ticket JIRA:CS-8421).

Immediate TODOs (by 2026-04-09):
- Jordan: finalize probability scoring rubric and share in #cs-renewals.
- Aisha: book Acme Analytics health-check for 2026-03-22 and post meeting notes to Confluence.
- Marcus: assemble Dedicated offering pricing scenarios and run with Finance (c.c. Priya).
- Priya: confirm BlueOrb legal contacts and prepare amendment draft.

Meeting cadence + usage:
- Weekly standup (Thu 11:00am PT) to review top-10 at-risk deals.
- Biweekly QBR prep working session (Mon 9:00am PT) 4 weeks before contract end for Enterprise accounts.

Audit trail and change log (short):
2026-03-15: initial draft created (Jordan).
2026-03-22: Acme row updated after health-check (Aisha).
2026-03-29: Nimbus probability decreased after exec change (Marcus).
2026-04-02: Added 'Escalation Required' flag and linked artifacts refs (Jordan).

Open questions / flags:
- Should we include a 'SaaS Usage Delta (90d)' column? Ops says this helps triage but will add noise; decision due 2026-04-09.
- Legal pricing floor for Dedicated offers — Finance sign-off required before presenting to Growth accounts.

Quick links:
- Confluence: CS/renewal-strategy-2026 (master strategy)
- JIRA: CS-8421 (pipeline refresh automation)
- Slack: #cs-renewals (operational channel)
- Template: Confluence:CS/playbooks-q2-2026

Notes to self (Jordan): keep this sheet intentionally messy — source-of-truth lives in SalesForce for signed commitments, this is an ops notebook for action-oriented tracking and playbook experimentation.
